chunks: Rijal al-Kashshi: Muhammad b. Nusayr, from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Isa, from al-Husayn b. Sai’d, from Ahmad b. Muhammad, from Abi al-Hasan al-Ridha (peace be upon him) who said:

Is there not for you in [the case of] Abi al-Hasan (peace be upon him) a warning! What do you think is the state of Hisham b. al-Hakam? For he is the one who did to Abi al-Hasan what he did, and he informed them and divulged to them [the secrets of the Madhhab]. Do you think Allah will forgive him what he has perpetrated on us!

key_terms.أَبِي الْحَسَنِ: Abi al-Hasan, referring to Imam Musa al-Kadhim (peace be upon him) in this context
key_terms.هشام بن الحكم: Hisham ibn al-Hakam, a prominent companion known for betraying the Imams

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of Hisham ibn al-Hakam's fate as a warning in Shia tradition?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) cites Hisham ibn al-Hakam as a cautionary example of those who betrayed the Imams by revealing their secrets, questioning whether his followers took heed from his fate. The Imam highlights the gravity of this betrayal by asking if God would forgive Hisham for the wrongs he committed against the Ahl al-Bayt, emphasizing the spiritual consequences of exposing the Imams' hidden truths to their enemies.

en.ammaar-muslim: 3. [3/277] Rijal al-Kashshi: Muhammad b. Nusayr from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Isa from al-Husayn b. Sai’d from Ahmad b. Muhammad [b. Abi Nasr] from Abi al-Hasan al-Ridha عليه السلام who said:

Is there not for you in [the case of] Abi al-Hasan [al-Kadhim] عليه السلام a warning! What do you think is the state of Hisham b. al-Hakam? For he is the one who did to Abi al-Hasan what he did, and he informed them and divulged to them [the secrets of the Madhhab]. Do you think Allah will forgive him what he has perpetrated on us!
